query:
SELECT mt.tableName, COUNT(mf.id) as fieldCount, mt.description
FROM metadata_tables mt 
LEFT JOIN metadata_fields mf ON mt.id = mf.tableId 
GROUP BY mt.tableName, mt.description
ORDER BY mt.tableName;
